formElement.label: Configuration Name:
formElement.documentation: Select the pre-configured Delinea Secret Server connection.

formElement.label: Secret ID:
formElement.documentation: Numeric ID of the secret in Delinea Secret Server (e.g., 2048 for SSH Keys, 1042 for DB/API secrets). Provide either Secret ID or Secret Path.

formElement.label: Secret Path:
formElement.documentation: Full path or unique name to lookup the secret (e.g., /DevOps/SSH/BastionKey). Used if Secret ID is omitted.

formElement.label: Field Slug:
formElement.documentation: Slug of the file attachment or private key field (e.g., private-key, certificate-file). Leave blank to auto-detect.

formElement.label: Destination Path:
formElement.documentation: Destination file path or directory on the CDRO agent (e.g., ~/.ssh/id_rsa or /tmp/cert.pfx).

formElement.label: File Permissions:
formElement.documentation: POSIX permissions for the saved file (e.g., 0600 for SSH keys, 0644 for general files).

formElement.label: Overwrite Existing File:
formElement.documentation: Whether to overwrite destination file if it already exists.

formElement.label: Output Property Sheet:
formElement.documentation: Path to the CDRO property sheet where file download metadata will be saved.
